changes: Setup next to other mod tools: Setup no longer stops when another tool has added cars or tracks to the game's own data.
Dusk races at the right time: At Spa a dusk race started in the dark, because the game keeps its own clock for some circuits.
Setup finds the right game folder: With several Steam libraries Setup could pick an old copy of the game.
New version notice: When a new version is out, the game's main menu tells you, the Vita Corsa tile shows it and the settings list it next to your own version.
Latest changes in the game: The list of changes is now in the game: open it from the menu or from the version line in the settings.
